### `PUT /api/projects/{project_id}/remediation-config`

**Put Remediation Config**

Validate and store the settings (replacing the previous ones). 422 with ``error_code``
``INVALID_REMEDIATION_CONFIG`` and nothing saved when the detector project is not a
code-findings project with a completed weighted run (or not accessible to the caller), a
check id is unknown, or ``top_k`` is outside 1..10.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `project_id` | `path` | `integer` | yes |  |

**Request body** (required)

Content type: `application/json` — `RemediationConfigBody`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `detector` | `DetectorBody \\| null` | no |  |
| `checks` | `string[] \\| null` | no | Code-check ids; null = every runnable check for the language. |
| `judge` | `boolean \\| null` | no |  |
| `retrieve_passages` | `boolean \\| null` | no |  |
| `top_k` | `integer \\| null` | no |  |

**Responses**

| Status | Schema | Description |

| `422` | `HTTPValidationError` | Validation Error |
